instruction.name: xvfnmadd.s
instruction.description: Compute packed single precision floating point FMA(Fused Multiply-Add): multiply elements in `a` and `b`, accumulate to elements in `c` and store the negated result in `dst`.

experiments.name: accumulator dependency chain
experiments.init: li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1073741824; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 1077936128; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr3, $r4

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 4.99; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.
